findings.rationale: effect_request silently discards the return value from pending.insert. Repeated or concurrent requests for the same irreversible effect and correlation ID therefore collapse into one pending entry without a finding; the only duplicate guard runs later on completion. Two irreversible requests issued before either completes can consequently be reported as conformant after one completion, defeating the replay's at-most-once check.

Both native and browser check paths return an ok AI-project envelope as soon as the heuristic is_ai_project predicate matches, without calling parse_ai_project. Malformed projects—including unterminated blocks, invalid numeric clauses, and duplicate declarations rejected by the public parser—are therefore accepted by check and CI-facing analysis.
